summary: Completed API regression and live desktop/mobile UI testing for Fresher Frenzy. Core health, registration, pass lookup, admin login, scan API, agenda, invitation, contacts, and responsive layout passed.

integration_issues.issue: After successful admin login, no scanner navigation/button is exposed. Scanner component and backend route exist, but a user cannot reach the manual scanner through the UI.

action_items: Expose an authenticated scanner entry from the command center or navigation and retest manual FF-TEST-001 verification.
Consider persisting registrations and admin sessions in MongoDB before production/multi-instance use; current server state is in-memory.
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner UI is implemented but unreachable from the rendered navigation/admin screen, so the requested admin scanner flow is incomplete.
Registrations and sessions are process-local dictionaries/sets; restart or another backend instance loses data and auth state.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely prefixed TEST registration through the API and one UI regression registration; both are in-memory test data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API suite is green. Invitation, agenda day switcher, native required validation, valid registration, async demo pass lookup, contacts/tel links, admin login, desktop load, and mobile overflow passed. Recheck scanner entry after E1 exposes it. No API mocks were used; the frontend contains an unexercised local registration/admin fallback.
rca of the issue: App.js renders Scanner only when tab === 'scan', but Nav() defines only home, agenda, join, pass, and contacts. Admin success navigates to tab 'admin' and Admin has no scanner link, leaving tab 'scan' unreachable through normal UI interaction.
